captions.detailed: A video astronomy tracking telescope featuring a short, dark blue cylindrical optical tube assembly with an orange mounting plate underneath and a small black camera mounted on top. The telescope is supported by a motorized single-arm alt-azimuth mount in black, which rests on a flat grey circular base atop a black tripod with three angled legs and thin silver cross-braces. The assembly articulates via a continuous azimuth rotation at the base of the arm and a revolute altitude rotation where the telescope clamps to the single arm.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a video astronomy tracking telescope on a motorized single-arm alt-azimuth mount. The model should feature a dark blue cylindrical telescope tube with an orange vixen rail and a top-mounted camera, connected via a revolute altitude joint to a single-arm mount that rotates continuously on a flat tripod base supported by three angled legs.
captions.factory: Construct a tripod base using three angled cylinders joined with thin horizontal cylindrical braces and a central vertical column. Model the azimuth head using stacked cylinders of varying diameters, and attach a single-arm mount constructed from offset rectangular boxes. For the telescope assembly, create a main cylinder for the optical tube, a smaller cylinder for the camera, and an elongated thin box for the orange mounting rail. Define two joints: a continuous azimuth joint rotating about the Z-axis at the base of the arm, and a revolute altitude joint rotating about the Y-axis where the telescope connects to the arm.
